question: Which of the following portals was launched in Punjab in June 2025 that has helped digitise land records and curb corruption in registry services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Easy Jamabandi Portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Easy Jamabandi Portal** was launched in **Punjab** in **June 2025** to digitize land records and enhance transparency in registry services.
 
• This portal aims to reduce **corruption** and ensure a seamless process for land-related transactions by providing easy access to digital records.
 
• The portal integrates advanced **technology** to manage land records, ensuring accuracy and reducing manual errors in data entry and retrieval.
 
• The initiative is part of the Punjab government's broader goal to promote **e-governance** and improve citizen services in the state.
 
• By digitizing land records, the portal has also helped resolve land disputes efficiently, saving time and resources for both the government and the citizens.
